chunks: From him, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn, from Muḥammad ibn Haytham, from Muḥammad ibn Isḥāq, who said:

I said to Abī al-Ḥasan al-Riḍā عليه السلام: There is something the people where we are do: they place their hands upon the grave when the deceased has been buried. He said: “That is only for one who did not catch the salat (prayer) over him; as for one who did catch the salat, then no.”

key_terms.الصَّلَاةَ: the funeral salat performed over the deceased
key_terms.الْقَبْرِ: the grave of the deceased after burial

ai.seo_question: Is placing the hands on a grave after burial recommended for everyone or only for someone who missed the funeral salat?
ai.summary: This hadith relates a legal ruling from Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام regarding placing one's hands on the grave after burial. He explains that this act is مخصوص for someone who missed the funeral salat over the deceased, and not for one who had already participated in that salat.
